description: This Java source file defines the MemoryAppender class which extends logging functionality for the OpenMRS platform by storing a configurable number of recent log lines, with support for deprecated subclasses and external log4j interfaces.

classes.name: MemoryAppender
classes.description: A deprecated Log4j appender class that stores recent log messages in memory, extending OpenMRS's custom MemoryAppender and delegating operations to an internal implementation.
